_meta.status: design spec — not wired to live execution
_meta.purpose: Route each trading day's decisions to the tactic whose edge matches the prevailing market regime, instead of running one strategy across all conditions.
notes: All trigger-side math (ATR, VWAP, EMA, OR levels) uses CURRENT-MONTH NIFTY FUTURE.
Option-side math (strike selection, PCR, OI walls, VIX) uses SPOT.
On last 3 trading days of current-month future, trigger math rolls to NEXT-MONTH FUTURE.
Weekly options always reference spot regardless of futures rollover.

data_requirements.option_chain: ATM ± 10 strikes, current weekly expiry, 1-minute OHLCV+OI per strike-side
data_requirements.event_calendar: static JSON of RBI / Fed / budget / major earnings dates with blackout windows

features.focus_oi_bias: put_oi_change_ratio vs call_oi_change_ratio in focus zone
features.event_flag: true if within event blackout window

classification_rules_priority_ordered.label: TREND_UP_GAP
classification_rules_priority_ordered.condition: gap_pct >= 0.005 AND OR_range_pct >= 0.25*avg_OR AND price > OR_high AND vwap_slope_30m > 0

classification_rules_priority_ordered.label: TREND_DOWN_GAP
classification_rules_priority_ordered.condition: gap_pct <= -0.005 AND OR_range_pct >= 0.25*avg_OR AND price < OR_low AND vwap_slope_30m < 0

classification_rules_priority_ordered.label: TREND_UP
classification_rules_priority_ordered.condition: adx_15m >= 25 AND range_ratio >= 1.2 AND vwap_slope_30m > 0 AND price > VWAP

classification_rules_priority_ordered.label: TREND_DOWN
classification_rules_priority_ordered.condition: adx_15m >= 25 AND range_ratio >= 1.2 AND vwap_slope_30m < 0 AND price < VWAP

regime_classifier.regime_change_rule: new label must sustain ≥ 15 min before switching; exception: EXPIRY / NO_TRADE flip immediately

on_regime_change.open_positions: if regime change is AGAINST the open position's bias, force-exit at market within 1 minute
on_regime_change.comment: Prevents carrying a losing trade through a regime flip

daily.action_on_halt: cancel pending, block new entries, keep managing open positions until close

portfolio.capital_allocation_across_tactics: dynamic — one active tactic at a time based on regime

data_source_rules.trigger_math_source: current-month Nifty future (rolls to next-month when DTE_fut <= 3)
data_source_rules.vwap_requires_volume: futures only (spot Nifty has no volume)

observability.classifier_log: logs/regime_YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl — one row per 5m with all features + label
observability.comment: These logs make post-hoc review possible and are essential for validating the classifier

integration.mode: dry_run (default) | shadow (logs what it would do alongside live bot) | live
integration.existing_bot_impact: none in dry_run/shadow; in live mode, existing signal_engine.py is fired only when router arms RANGE

open_decisions_for_user: Confirm hysteresis sustain window (15m vs 10m vs 20m) — affects responsiveness vs whipsaw
Confirm VIX hard no-trade threshold (28 vs 30) — how conservative on volatility spikes?
Confirm max trades per day (8) and max consecutive losses (3) for daily halt
Decide: should CHOP regime run a different tactic (e.g. straddle selling) or stay as NO_TRADE?
